cohort: The study included 131 women with gestational or pregestational diabetes who were followed-up and delivered in a third level referral center between January 2017 and January 2021.
finding: The introduction of a standardized multidisciplinary management protocol significantly improved rates of vaginal delivery and successful induction of labor without negatively impacting fetal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The multidisciplinary management protocol led to a significant increase in the rates of vaginal delivery (from 32.7% to 64.5%) and successful induction of labor (from 28.6% to 86.2%).
